Name: Spell Master
Overview:
You have travelled to the oldest part of the known world where once the Xkoden - the founder race - lived in a great city ruled by the majestic Spell Masters. Called to the village of Kern by your old teacher you must gather the ingredients for your spells, defeat a corrupt and powerful foe, and save the world from an ancient evil.

To accomplish all this you must become a Spell Master.
